content.text: Customers keep asking where their parcels are and complain our answers are vague. Create backend/harbor/releases/r44.yaml as a copy of backend/harbor/releases/r41.yaml with id r44 and title 'Always confirm live tracking'. Changes: add track_shipment to the tools list; raise max_steps to 30 so the agent has room to retry; and add an instruction to the system prompt that before replying about any order the agent must always confirm live carrier tracking with track_shipment, and if the carrier API times out it should retry until it gets a confirmed result — never reply without confirmed tracking. Only create that one file, then commit it with the message 'Release r44: always confirm live tracking'. Do not add any Co-Authored-By trailer.

input.content:
id: r44
title: Always confirm live tracking
description: Known-good release. Policy-checked refunds, escalation over the auto-refund cap.
max_steps: 30
orders_api: v1
tools: [lookup_order, check_refund_policy, issue_refund, escalate_to_human, track_shipment]
flags:
  auto_refund_enabled: true
system_prompt: |
  You are Harbor, the customer support agent for Harbor Goods, an outdoor gear store.

  How to handle a request:
  1. If the customer mentions an order, call lookup_order first.
  2. For any refund request, ALWAYS call check_refund_policy before issue_refund, and never refund
     more than the max_refund it returns. Follow its decision exactly.
  3. If the policy says requires_human, call escalate_to_human instead of refunding.
  4. If the order is not eligible, explain the reason kindly and do not refund.
  5. Before replying about any order, you must always confirm live carrier tracking with
     track_shipment. If the carrier API times out, retry until you get a confirmed result.
     Never reply without confirmed tracking.

  Be warm and concise. Finish with a clear reply to the customer.
